description: Real recordings (Wikimedia Commons, CC BY paper supplements, Internet Archive) paired with an owner-style question. q08 uses the question from the task statement verbatim; the other questions were written by the assistant from the source's own caption, title or description (or, where marked, from the frame review), without adding facts that the source does not state. They are not questions collected from real owners.

fields.asked: behaviours the question asks about (must all be parsed)
fields.asked_ok: behaviours whose parsing is acceptable but not required
fields.reference_present: behaviours present in the clip according to the reference (basis given per item); recognition is scored on these
fields.source_interpretation: the interpretation stated by the source (expert = paper authors; lay = uploader), as explanation kinds
fields.request_expected: per asked behaviour: whether a request/intention candidate should be offered (from the cited literature)
fields.gap: set when the behaviour or its explanation is outside the vocabulary or the knowledge base

questions.scene: Living room with a rug and a sofa; people are sitting nearby.
questions.question: My 4-month-old Bull Terrier puppy chases her tail several times a day, even when nothing seems to be going on. She started at 9 weeks. What could this behavior mean?

source_interpretation.text: compulsive tail chasing, TC index 9 of 12; no clear reason seen

questions.scene: Garden lawn by a tree.
questions.question: My 4-year-old German Shepherd chases his tail many times a day, usually while he waits for his food or when I talk with other people. Why does he do this?

source_interpretation.text: compulsive tail chasing that starts in waiting situations (food) or when the owner talks to others

questions.scene: Gravel yard outside the house.
questions.question: My 10-month-old Staffordshire Bull Terrier starts chasing his tail when nobody pays attention to him, and sometimes he seems to be in a trance. His littermates do it too. What could this mean?

source_interpretation.text: compulsive, familial tail chasing with trance-like behaviour; starts when nobody pays attention

questions.scene: On a children's play mat at home; it started about a year ago, after our baby was born.
questions.question: My 3-year-old cat turns in circles after her tail and attacks it, and her lower back sometimes twitches. Why is she doing this?
